objective: Discover and independently validate a novel frontier-competitive sequence/computational architecture using coordinated parallel falsifiable research, before selective integration into TAC-OSM / PLM.

governance.research_director: Maintains frozen questions, lane contracts, dependency order, compute caps and a balanced portfolio; cannot certify its own hypotheses.
governance.lane_leads: Produce hypotheses, code, trials and failure reports independently; findings are evidence candidates.
governance.replication_lead: Independent worker/session repeats frozen runs and checks leakage, ablations, complete seeds and exact artifact hashes.
governance.integration_lead: Ports only qualified mechanisms behind stable module contracts, benchmarks complete assembled models and measures interactions.
governance.human_authority: Required for paid GPU budgets, public novelty/state-of-the-art claims, changes to final test suites, training scale advancement and merge/release.

science_rules: Never relabel a reported source experiment as independently rerun, nor a deterministic store as a trained neural result.
Freeze datasets/splits/seed lists, model parameters, batch+token budget, evaluation code, baselines, kernel settings and selection criterion before final evaluation.
Use three or more matched seeds for initial evidence; five or more or independent distribution replications for promotion where statistically feasible.
Pair model size (within 1% when practical) and tune baselines at matched optimizer steps/tokens/FLOPs and reasonable search budgets.
Compare quality, training FLOPs, wall clock, GPU memory, decode latency, and total energy where measured; never call FLOP reductions measured speedups.
Retain failed seeds and negative results; any change after blind holdout means a new test version.
Compare mechanisms through isolated component removal, alternative same-cost mechanism and state interventions.
Present confidence intervals and task-specific effect sizes; no composite leaderboard from incompatible metrics.
Do not claim frontier capability from synthetic-only results, no-fit implementations, report-level summaries or incomplete training.
Research protocols and evidence may be parallel; shared hidden final test sets must remain quarantined from training/tuning.

scales.minimum: Evidence of training and causal mechanism effect
Matched Transformer/GRU/SSM and end-to-end language evaluation
Mechanistic gains survive deeper model and longer training
Real-text capability, compute-optimal quality and external validation

gates.label: Correctness and source recovery
gates.rule: Pinned authentic code/data, runnable smoke, gradient checks, parameter accounting, frozen protocol

gates.label: Mechanism discovery
gates.rule: Paired train results over >=3 seeds beat relevant no-mechanism or matched alternative on preregistered target metric

gates.label: Causal and robust validation
gates.rule: Independent replay; state knockout/swap/control, load-length disentanglement, unseen distributions, uncertainty and negative results

gates.label: Integration promotion
gates.rule: Full backbone + mechanism shows a nontrivial Pareto improvement on target metrics without preregistered unacceptable regression; full GPU profile and equal compute

gates.label: Scale and external qualification
gates.rule: 10M -> 50M -> 100M+ after progressive real-data tests, blind holdout, accepted external baseline and independent replication

interfaces.common_adapter: Module.forward(x, state, mask, context)-> (features, new_state, diagnostics); a no-state adapter is permitted.
interfaces.state_contract: Typed shapes/initial/reset/detach/serialize; carry/reset/swap/read-only ablations; never silently consume future target information.
interfaces.compute_contract: Record parameter counts, optimizer configs, GPU/kernel versions, FLOPs estimate, wall time and bytes; inapplicable dimensions marked N/A.
interfaces.evidence_contract: Every claim points to source commit, training receipt, data manifest, metric manifest and failure taxonomy; report-only remains unverified.

integration_policy.baseline_first: Keep TAC_CORE unchanged as an equal-budget reference, plus strongest external rival and simple shortcut diagnostics.
integration_policy.eligible: Only G2 mechanisms may be integration candidates; G3 must be earned by integrated improvement not standalone score.
integration_policy.interaction_studies: Test mechanism A and B separately and combined with equal parameter/compute costs; check synergistic and antagonistic interactions.
integration_policy.selection: Maintain a Pareto frontier, not a single arbitrary weighted score. Prefer smallest module yielding reproducible quality, throughput, retrieval or adaptability gain.
integration_policy.rollback: Remove module if downstream regressions, reproducibility failure, data contamination or physical compute cost falsify benefit.

lanes.hypothesis: Train a width/depth-scalable persistent-state backbone, not assumed superior to attention.
lanes.primary_outcome: Matched quality per training FLOP and decode throughput
lanes.next_falsifier: Freeze a matched 1M/10M suite including long decoding, high-temperature text and carried-state knockout

lanes.hypothesis: Learn selective persistent writes, readout and verification.
lanes.primary_outcome: Delayed keyed recall and correct write correction
lanes.next_falsifier: Fix fresh append-adapter value retrieval on held-out histories before integration

lanes.hypothesis: Test whether node/pulse communication improves local/global computation.
lanes.primary_outcome: Unseen operation composition at matched model size and cost
lanes.next_falsifier: Remove pulse path under frozen seeds and matched decoder

lanes.hypothesis: Learn graph-structured memory with correct deletion and supersession.
lanes.next_falsifier: Compare graph association update versus explicit replacement after unrelated-key edits

lanes.hypothesis: Use stable recurrent field dynamics without losing address selectivity.
lanes.primary_outcome: Gradient stability and old-key recall with long delays
lanes.next_falsifier: Factor relevance gating from query addressing and audit retrieval at fixed context

lanes.hypothesis: Test whether non-Euclidean transport actually enables structural generalization.
lanes.next_falsifier: Specify a geometry-requiring task and ablate transport

lanes.hypothesis: Test specialized local populations and adaptive routing.
lanes.next_falsifier: Qualify fresh-factor learning before measuring retention

lanes.hypothesis: Test local plasticity and neural-field dynamics for online adaptation.
lanes.primary_outcome: Retention/adaptation tradeoff across delays and seeds
lanes.next_falsifier: Freeze compact features and test fresh seeds and longer delays

lanes.hypothesis: Develop learned address/value-separated corrective and collective memory.
lanes.next_falsifier: Hold load and sequence length independently; compare split-address and matrix state; stress multiple writes

lanes.hypothesis: Sparse structure selection, survival and lifecycle management.
lanes.primary_outcome: Real accelerator throughput plus structured transfer
lanes.next_falsifier: Profile gather/scatter and require an actual GPU win at comparable accuracy

lanes.hypothesis: Persist, update and reuse task-dependent routing under resource scarcity.
lanes.primary_outcome: Future ablation and dynamic policy cost at fixed success
lanes.next_falsifier: Test energy-calibrated stopping with wrong-future and stale-state interventions

lanes.hypothesis: Discover and reuse executable structures with verifiable repair.
lanes.primary_outcome: Novel-operator transfer and held-out repair success
lanes.next_falsifier: Make full stateful repair surpass decoder-only with blind compositional tests

lanes.hypothesis: Evaluate geometric representation and transformation inductive biases.
lanes.primary_outcome: Geometric OOD prediction/transfer, not visual plausibility
lanes.next_falsifier: Train geometry-pretext and matched text controls; isolate geometric mechanism

lanes.primary_outcome: Bits per byte, accuracy and sequence efficiency
lanes.next_falsifier: Address observed BYTE routing collapse using frozen compute and held-out text

lanes.hypothesis: Compare predictive, structured, executable and verifier-conditioned training.
lanes.next_falsifier: Train exact same backbone and data with controlled objectives

lanes.hypothesis: Implement correct parallel scans and high-throughput state updates.
lanes.next_falsifier: Reconcile sequential/parallel gradients and benchmark T4 with actual events

lanes.hypothesis: Study reliable temporal reconstruction, retraction, provenance and ownership.
lanes.primary_outcome: Correct temporal truth/retraction with zero unauthorized disclosure
lanes.next_falsifier: Build timeline/edit benchmark independent of language model implementation

lanes.hypothesis: Use the architecture in long-document visual transcription as a transfer stress test.
lanes.primary_outcome: Character/word error and page throughput on authentic held-out scans
lanes.next_falsifier: Establish real image-grounding and leak-free multilingual test set before scaling
